Collision Work / Collision Repairs

Photos coming soon

Expert Automotive Care on Royal Windsor Drive

Being involved in a traffic accident is stressful enough without having to navigate complicated insurance paperwork and repair logistics. At Royal Drive Mechanics, we take the headache out of collision repairs by working directly with your insurance adjuster.

Our experienced body and mechanical technicians handle structural straightening, panel replacement, color-matched refinishing, and full mechanical re-alignment in-house. Because we are both a mechanical garage and a collision facility, we inspect and repair underlying steering, suspension, and sensor components that typical body shops might overlook.

You have the legal right under Ontario insurance laws to choose the repair facility of your choice for insurance claims. Choose the dedicated care and precision of Royal Drive Mechanics.

Step-by-Step Collision Repair Procedure:

Step 01

Assessment & Damage Documentation

We carefully inspect your vehicle's exterior panels, structural frame, and mechanical components, taking detailed photographic documentation of all damage.

Step 02

Insurance Estimate & Direct Coordination

We prepare an itemized repair estimate and submit it directly to your insurance company adjuster to secure quick authorization without delay.

Step 03

Precision Body & Mechanical Repair

Our certified technicians perform structural alignment, dent repairs, panel replacements, computer paint matching, and mechanical recalibration.

Step 04

Multi-Point Quality & Safety Check

Before handing back your keys, we perform a comprehensive quality audit, road test, and final vehicle wash to ensure your vehicle is returned in pristine condition.

What's Included in Our Collision Repairs Package

  • ✓ Direct coordination and electronic estimating with all major Canadian insurance providers
  • ✓ Unibody and frame alignment assessment
  • ✓ Bumper, fender, quarter panel, and door repair or replacement
  • ✓ Computerized color-matched paint refinishing and clear coat blending
  • ✓ Post-collision mechanical inspection (suspension, steering, alignment, radiators)
  • ✓ ADAS sensor calibration and safety systems reset

⚠ Signs You Need This Service

  • • Involved in an accident, collision, or parking lot impact
  • • Cracked, loose, or dented front or rear bumper cover
  • • Fender, hood, door, or quarter panel body creases and scratch damage
  • • Car pulls violently or handles abnormally after an impact
  • • Processing an insurance claim and need a trusted repair partner

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Q. Do I have to use the body shop my insurance company recommends?

No. In Ontario, you have the absolute legal right to choose any licensed repair facility you trust. Insurance companies cannot force you to use their preferred supplier.

Q. Can you help me deal with my insurance claim paperwork?

Yes, we work directly with all major insurance companies and handle communications, photographic estimates, and supplemental damage claims on your behalf.

Q. Do you handle both mechanical damage and body work from an accident?

Yes! Because we are both a licensed mechanical workshop and collision repair center, we restore both cosmetic body panels and underlying suspension or mechanical components under one roof.
